g.title: TARGET
g.text: One Company | Multiple Shops | Company-wide employee password + global roles | Signed integer stock | VAT feature flag | 12-month refurbished guarantee | Service procurement | Shop/date closing

g.title: authorization
g.text: PK id; FK session, shop, employee

g.title: payment
g.text: PK id; FK shop_id, employee_id, auth_id

g.title: cashmove
g.text: PK id; FK shop_id, employee_id, auth_id

g.title: closing
g.text: PK id; FK shop_id, closing_employee_id, auth_id

g.title: procurementrequest
g.text: One purchasing round; many per service order

g.title: shop->actionapproval
g.text: 1:N; financial actions only; no procurement approval

g.title: note
g.text: PK id; FK sale_id XOR order_id

g.title: procurementimage
g.text: role, caption, order; uploader/audit in STORED_IMAGE
